verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public web API at docs.sentry.io/api, including endpoints such as bulk-mutating issues. It also publishes an official machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec ("Sentry Public API") in getsentry/sentry-api-schema and has a stated versioning policy (v0, stable public endpoints, beta endpoints subject to change). The probe 404s for openapi.json on the docs domain only show the spec lives on GitHub instead, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Sentry via the API, evidence of endpoint breadth beyond a single named endpoint, and documented API authentication details.
